A Fachbereich 03 Empirische Kulturwissenschaft page states that information taken directly or indirectly from AI tools must be marked, otherwise it is a deception attempt; this claim is limited to that page's department-scoped guidance.

The HRZ AI services page says the university offers generative AI services via GWDG KI-Cloud and lists usage rules including no prompt/file input of personal, confidential, or security-relevant data and transparent disclosure when the service is used.
The central teaching-and-AI orientation recommends that, for written work, AI-generated text parts be marked as such as a matter of good scientific practice.

Philipps-Universität Marburg's central teaching-and-AI orientation says the university does not prohibit generative AI and frames the guidance around exploring productive use in teaching and teaching organization.
